context: Drive the bulk path end-to-end against the existing fake_libsql fixture: stage a small fixture corpus, seed the fake target with a colliding finding_events row so the PK offset is genuinely exercised, transfer, then assert parity_report ok plus the expected row counts per findings table. Assert the items domain on the target is untouched.
description:
`todo finding import --bulk` has 7 tests covering its refuse-by-default target guard (missing/mismatched --confirm-target, local backend, missing token, missing replica, dry-run never transferring), but ZERO tests exercise the path that actually moves data: stage_corpus_import -> offset_staging_pks -> bulk_transfer(tables=FINDINGS_TRANSFER_TABLES) -> parity_report against the target.

That flow was proven once, by hand, against a scratch Turso database (64 records, 432 rows, 3.0s, parity ok). Nothing in CI would catch a regression in it. The guard tests give a misleading impression of coverage: they all fail BEFORE any transfer happens, so the transfer could break entirely and every test would still pass.

tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_db_hosted.py already has a `fake_libsql` fixture that stands in for the hosted backend, which is the obvious vehicle -- the phase-3 hosted migration test uses it the same way.

anti_patterns.dont: Assert only that the call returns without raising
anti_patterns.instead: assert per-table row counts on the target and a clean parity_report
anti_patterns.why: the defect class here is silent partial transfer, which a smoke assertion cannot distinguish from success

anti_patterns.instead: use unit + medium markers, matching the sibling findings and hosted suites
anti_patterns.why: the fast-lane cap in _project/config/fast_test_lane_policy.json has near-zero headroom and CI's timing_policy_check --strict trips on any addition

anti_patterns.instead: pre-seed a row whose id collides with staging so the PK offset is actually exercised
anti_patterns.why: an empty target is precisely what hid the finding_events.seq=1 collision during the real scratch rehearsal

preserves.behavior: No new test module lands in the fast lane
The existing guard tests keep passing unchanged
